sql:
select cls,
  sum(case when fished_date_t >= 485.875 - 14 then yt else 0 end) as yt_14,
  sum(case when fished_date_t >= 485.875 - 14 then anglers else 0 end) as ang_14,
  count(case when fished_date_t >= 485.875 - 14 then 1 end) as n_14,
  sum(case when fished_date_t >= 485.875 - 30 then yt else 0 end) as yt_30,
  sum(case when fished_date_t >= 485.875 - 30 then anglers else 0 end) as ang_30,
  count(case when fished_date_t >= 485.875 - 30 then 1 end) as n_30
from trips
where fished_date_season = 2
group by cls
order by cls
